item.title: Gambonanza Complete Walkthrough (v1.1.0)-Step-by-Step Run Guide
item.description:
This Is Not a Quick Primer-It’s Your Campaign Map

Gambonanza blends chess with roguelike progression in a way that’s incredibly satisfying-but the learning curve hits hard. This guide won’t drill you on micro-tactics. It tells you what to do and when to do it.

Verdict

Beginners make exactly two critical mistakes: over-expanding in the opening, and failing to transition in the mid-game. Fix those two things, and reaching Grand Master is just a matter of reps. If you need a shortcut, the Beginner Guide covers the 5 rules that carry you through your first 5 runs. Each boss phase demands a different approach - check the Boss Guide for phase-by-phase tactics. Difficulty Rating: A-steep at first, but every run teaches you something.
